name: Nahbi
title: Spy from the tribe of Naphtali
summary: Nahbi, son of Vofsi, was the representative from the tribe of Naphtali among the twelve spies that Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He was one of the ten spies who returned with a negative report and discouraged the Israelites from entering the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as a Spy
keyEvents.description: Nahbi, son of Vofsi, was chosen by Moses as the representative of the tribe of Naphtali to spy out the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Sending of the Spies
keyEvents.description: Moses sent Nahbi and the other eleven spies from the wilderness of Paran to explore the land of Canaan and report on its people and resources.

keyEvents.title: Exploring Canaan
keyEvents.description: Nahbi and the other spies spent forty days exploring the land of Canaan, from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob near Lebo-Hamat.

keyEvents.title: The Negative Report
keyEvents.description: Nahbi was among the ten spies who gave a negative report about Canaan, claiming that the inhabitants were too strong to defeat, which spread fear among the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: The People's Rebellion
keyEvents.description: The negative report from Nahbi and the other spies led the entire congregation of Israel to rebel against Moses and Aaron, wanting to return to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on the Spies
keyEvents.description: As punishment for their lack of faith and the negative report, Nahbi and the other ten spies were struck by a plague and died in the Lord's sight. Only Joshua and Caleb were spared.
